svg.title: Similar accuracy, different coverage
svg.desc: Selected replay origins in source block 11, on the same 256 targeted arithmetic items. R-S has raw Pass@1 35.72% and at least one success on 170 items. R-P has raw Pass@1 34.59% and at least one success on 247 items. Each square represents 16 recorded draws on one item. Squares are sorted independently by success count, not paired by position.
svg.text: Same 256 targeted items · 16 draws per item · source block 11
Each square is one item, sorted by success count within its arm; positions are not matched across grids.
